title: Table 2.1b Storage provisions (minimum storage area)
notes: Minimum dimension 1.5 m (length and width; reducible to 1 m under C2.1.9), minimum height 2.1 m, location behind the primary street setback; all constant across rows, carried in rule C2.1.8. Key is the bedroom count of the apartment with the least compliant storage. Storage can be co-located within a garage or carport but must be a dedicated area; dimensions and areas exclude services, plant, utilities, bin storage, bicycle parking and fixtures. Differs from Chapter 3 Table 2.1b (no 3+ bed row, 1 m, 2 m).
